newsitem.title: USA: PP&L Resources restarts Susquehanna Unit 1.
newsitem.headline: PP&L Resources restarts Susquehanna Unit 1.

text.p: PP&L Resources Inc said Sunday that operators restarted its Susquehanna Unit 1 nuclear power plant after after one week following repairs to a leak in a pipe inside the reactor building.
The company said in a press release that the leak was "pinhole-sized" and was discovered during routine inspections.
The unit was taken offline on October 28.
"We replaced about 15 feet of pipe and corrected the problem. We also did other maintenance work," Herbert Woodeshick, special assistant to the president, said in the press statement.
Susqehanna's Unit 2 reactor was not affected and is operating fully, the company said.
